Migration and architecture validators

No database writer
No OAuth, MCP, Native, workflow, or finalizer cutover
No performance claim

milestones.title: Typed contract and pure policy core
milestones.functional_goal: Move stable side-effect-free contracts and policies to typed Rust while preserving exact source behavior.
scope: Errors and enums
JSON/schema validation
Redaction and fingerprints
URL/path/command policy
Patch and other pure parsers
non_goals: No production persistence
No process ownership
No workflow or network authority

milestones.title: Native process lifecycle and isolation plane

Toolchain exposure policy
Bubblewrap helper protocol and attestation
Owned Quick Tunnel child lifecycle

No private-vault exposure
No application-specific CAS allowlist

milestones.title: Persistence, project state, and capability authority

Promotion idempotency and optimistic conflicts
Capability issue, validation, registry cross-check, and revocation

No workflow transition redesign
No schema version change without a separate record

HTTP route and Origin policy

Exact 18 Native plus 6 Rethlas public catalog and hidden aliases
Tool dispatch boundary

No tool-catalog redesign
No auth weakening for compatibility

Private vault and memory visibility
Proof manifests and reference audits
Mechanical verdict, final artifact, and project promotion

No second finalizer
No model-controlled verified label

No UI authority over security or workflow
No provider trust expansion
